producing_agent.identity: Cursor Grok 4.6 (cloud agent, under J. Brown direction)

hypothesis: A cheap five-field signature is not a function to gold. A menu-relative coarsest-representing map is a function, is natural under 0↔3 relabelling, and is Theorem 4 plus a total order. Uniqueness without that tie-break fails. Possibility 1 as a new master object dies; the written function is SIC.
decision: Accept calculus_is_sic if κ_cheap is not a function, κ_screen matches gold on every registered case, uniqueness fails without the tie-break, and Path A/B disagree. Accept calculus_holds if the cheap signature is already a function. Accept no_function if κ_screen misses. Any of those three is a valid passing run.

kill_criteria.KAP_RELABEL: Kill the instrument if the disclosed relabel fails.
kill_criteria.KAP_RANKING_RECORDED: Kill the instrument if the verdict is missing.

kill_criteria.possibility_1_no_function: Reopen a cheap calculus if κ_cheap is a function on this suite.

audit_card.target_object: Three specified maps: κ_cheap, κ_screen, κ_unique. Decision: is Possibility 1 a new calculus, SIC's screen, or nonexistent?
audit_card.decision: Accept calculus_is_sic only when the cheap map is not a function and the working map is menu-relative Theorem 4.
audit_card.representation: Paper E suite on {0,1}^4 plus Aff(1, Z/3) cycles. Fibre counts and representability. Path A/B on Nat×Nat.
audit_card.data_clock: None. Finite enumeration. No sampling. No LLM. Maps specified before the run.
material_assumptions: κ must be written before gold is inspected for fitting.
The cheap signature is the Paper E five-field record.
κ_screen may look at the menu. That is disclosed, not hidden.
Coarsest means fewest fibres, then lexicographic screen id.
Path A/B is the schedule form of uniqueness, already Lean-checked.

objects.kappa_screen: (Y, q, Menu, edges) → action × chosen screen
objects.Coarsest: argmin (n(r), name) over representing r in Menu

mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: X = {0,1}^4. Fibre counts are dimensionless integers. Actions are a four-element set. Holonomy is Aff(1, Z/3). Path A/B lives on Nat×Nat.
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: There exist two registered cases with equal cheap signatures and unequal gold. For every registered case, kappa_screen's action equals empirical gold. There exists a case with more than one representing menu screen. There exist p,q with pathA(p)=pathA(q) and pathB(p)≠pathB(q).
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Universal over the 11 registered cases for kappa_screen. Existential for the cheap collision, the non-unique representing set, and the Path A/B pair.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Menu is {q_id, q_rot, q_perm, q_stab0, q_stab_last}. Connection gold ignores the PE screen. Tie-break is fewest fibres then name. No sampling.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: kappa_screen is identified as Theorem 4 plus that total order. It is not identified as a new primitive.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: Paper A representability iff G_M ⊆ G_Y. Paper E gold and decide. Lean repair_paths_disagree. CommonSuffScreen / Theorem 4. Not a new logical primitive.
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: Swap of positions 0 and 3 sends first_bit to last_bit and q_stab0 to q_stab_last. kappa_screen is required to commute with that relabel on the registered pairs.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: If the cheap signature does not collide, calculus_holds. If kappa_screen misses, no_function. If the menu is enlarged so pair_eq becomes quotientable, the cheap collision may disappear; that is a menu change.

compute.sampling: Finite {0,1}^4 enumeration, Paper E suite, Path A/B pair. No sampling.

claim_boundary: Accepted only as: the written function is SIC's screen plus a total order. Not a new master object. Not text nomination. Not an LLM. Not a better language model.
